summary:
I wrote plan.md (nothing built or rendered). Soames-Dunn: a two-storey shop row facing west on Pike Place, with a taller range stepping up the bluff behind it. Brick piers, cream panels with paired windows, one long dark-oak awning; the brown Starbucks front, sign and round logo sit beside a blue Bavarian Meats board.
Butterworth: a long flat-roofed red-brick block, four storeys on 1st Avenue and six on its Pike Place back. Arched top two floors, a heavy sandstone cornice and a projecting entrance with a BUTTERWORTH name panel; the Kells pub front sits in the back basement.
It reads as the real north end because of the stepped slope, real names, brick-and-cream palette, flat parapet roofs and warm-lit shops; all blocks pass the 1.21.1 check.
